examples.label: Linear elasticity · drained compression
examples.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Constant elastic stiffness gives reversible stress changes; this monotonic path does not demonstrate yielding or cyclic soil behaviour. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

examples.label: Drucker–Prager · drained compression
examples.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Pressure-dependent perfect plasticity with nonassociated flow. This example uses the smooth-cone/apex model without a separate tensile cutoff or hardening. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.

examples.label: Modified Cam Clay · drained compression
examples.description: 1% drained axial compression in 100 increments from explicit 100 kPa isotropic effective stress and void ratio 0.7. Pressure-dependent yielding and evolving preconsolidation pressure. The explicit initial preconsolidation pressure is 200 kPa at 100 kPa isotropic effective stress; the exponential finite-step hardening is the atlas discretization. Parameters illustrate the equation response and are not a specimen calibration.
